question: Under what condition may initiation proceed without the usual consideration of a guru?
premises: A suitable opportunity may be obtained
The usual consideration of a guru is normally required
That consideration can be abandoned in this case
inference: O beloved, if one obtains such an opportunity, one should then initiate, having abandoned consideration of a guru.
uncertainties: The referent of 'tāntu' is unclear in this transmission.
plain_english: O beloved, if one obtains such an opportunity, one should then initiate, having set aside consideration of a guru.
